subject: science
concept: Comparing plant and animal cells and identifying their key structural differences
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts cell-structure cards (cell wall, chloroplast, large vacuole) into plant-only versus shared categories
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a labeled cell diagram to whether it's a plant or animal cell
exercise.abstract: Student lists at least two structural differences between plant and animal cells

misconception_flags: believes animal cells also have cell walls or chloroplasts

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
